content.value: devise hybrids to fill the holes, with the following applications in (15) mind:

(i) Sheet steel (as used in car body panel, for instance) is prone to lightly damped flexural vibrations. Devise a hybrid sheet that combines the high stiffness, E, of steel with high loss coefficient, n.
(ii) Devise a hybrid with low modulus E and low loss coefficient, n.
